title: codexlb2otel: Response / thread lookup
description: Paste a response id, request id, thread id or session id; get the turn's metadata, its timing breakdown, and the conversation in order. Issue #15's deferred dashboard.

list.name: resolved_thread_id
list.label: Resolved thread id (auto)
list.query: label_values({service_name="$service_name"} | codexlb_request_id="$id" or gen_ai_response_id="$id" or codexlb_thread_id="$id" or gen_ai_conversation_id="$id" or codexlb_session_id="$id", codexlb_thread_id)

options.content: Paste any of the four ids into `$id`: a `resp_*` response id, a `ws_*`/bare-UUID request id, a thread id, or a session id (issue #15's id-collision table). All four are structured metadata on every emitted Loki record (internal/attr's Identity-class fields, always present via guard.Metadata regardless of Loki label promotion), so the first panel matches on whichever one you pasted directly. The **third panel resolves `$id` to its thread_id first** (via the `$resolved_thread_id` chained variable below, a Loki `label_values()` query that runs the same 5-way match), then lists every prompt/message/tool_call/tool_output/agent_message line on that thread, oldest first - matching a response id lands you on the **whole conversation** it belongs to, not just the one turn, per issue #15's worked example.

panels.title: Matching turn / transport / error record(s)
panels.description: Structured-metadata OR-filter across all four id kinds, per Loki's boolean label-filter-expression support. Raw JSON body shown as-is; turn.go's json tags name every field.

targets.expr: {service_name="$service_name", codexlb_record_type=~"turn|transport|error"} | codexlb_request_id="$id" or gen_ai_response_id="$id" or codexlb_thread_id="$id" or gen_ai_conversation_id="$id" or codexlb_session_id="$id"

panels.title: Timing breakdown (turn record only)
panels.description: Named `| json` field extraction off the turn line's own body (turn.go's json tags, including the nested critical_path object) - each extracted field becomes its own table column in Grafana's Loki table view.

targets.expr: {service_name="$service_name", codexlb_record_type="turn"} | codexlb_request_id="$id" or gen_ai_response_id="$id" or codexlb_thread_id="$id" or gen_ai_conversation_id="$id" or codexlb_session_id="$id" | json response_id="response_id", model="model", effort="reasoning_effort", service_tier="service_tier", thread_source="thread_source", subagent_kind="subagent_kind", parent_thread_id="parent_thread_id", previous_response_id="previous_response_id", ttft_ms="ttft_ms", pre_inference_ms="pre_inference_ms", engine_wall_ms="critical_path.engine_wall_ms", harness_unblocked_ms="critical_path.harness_unblocked_ms", sampling_stream_ms="critical_path.sampling_and_stream_ms", client_tool_pause_ms="critical_path.client_tool_pause_ms", coverage="critical_path.coverage"

panels.title: Conversation in order (resolved thread)
panels.description: Sorted oldest-first. Uses $resolved_thread_id (chained off $id), not $id directly, so a response/request/session id pasted into $id still returns the FULL conversation, not just the one turn it names.
